title: Kagamine Rin — Happy Anniversary! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey everyone! I'm Kagamine Rin! Thank you for coming to me and Len's special anniversary event!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow! You're all so pumped!
How about you guys watching the stream?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Happy anniversary, Rin!>
<I've been waiting for this!!!>
<I'm so excited!!!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like you guys have been looking forward to today too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Awesome! I'll do my best to blow you all away!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, here we go. Let's start my half!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Here's the first song!
song00001_off_f

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Heya! It's me, Kagamine Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Don't forget, I'm one of today's stars too!
I'm not gonna lose to Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We still have many more guests joining us on stage today!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We want to make sure everyone has a good time, so we'll be singing our hearts out too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's go with this song next!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, everyone! How're you liking the show so far?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe, I'm glad you're having a fun time!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That duet relay just now was super fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: When you said you'd be doing a duet with four people, I thought you were going to split into pairs. But instead, you rotated and sang a duet with each of the others.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Good work out there, Rin!
I never would've come up with a singing arrangement like that. It was super fun.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I had so much fun too! Thanks for doing it with me!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Co.
rows.Line: You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Okay, how about we take a quick break?
We've got some time until the prep for the next song is finished!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You guys can go rest!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks. Alright, we'll see you later!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, while we're taking a break, it's time for our chat.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'd say it's more of an interview as opposed to a chat.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! When we announced that we'd be doing a special anniversary event, we asked everyone for some questions.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Thank you for sending in your questions, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Since this is Rin's half, I'll be asking her the questions you sent in for her!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Okay, first question!
“Tell us how you feel right now, celebrating another anniversary!”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm super happy! So many creators have let me sing their songs and so many people have been listening to them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: On top of that, I'm able to hold this event, and everyone has been wishing me a happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I totally get you! It's great to hear everyone cheering here, and we've been getting lots of comments too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright, second question!
“What's your plan until your next anniversary?”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm, that's a good question...
I think I want to sing different kinds of songs and deliver their feelings to lots of people!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hahaha. The two of us really do love singing, huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Okay, last question!
“Have you received an anniversary present?”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe. I sure have.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I received sooooo many anniversary wishes from all the people here for this event today!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I had a feeling you'd say that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But there are some people here who'd also like to give you a message.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right, you guys?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Is this...?
song00010_off_s

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Rin!
I'm so happy that I was able to help out with this event.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's do our best to keep the energy up for Len's half after this!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Happy anniversary. It was so cute seeing you run around the stage like a little ball of energy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm certain that you've made not only me, but everyone gathered here smile. Thank you so much for such a fun time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We're the ones who're supposed to be making sure you have fun, and yet it's as if you've turned the tables on us. That's just how fun this event has been.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I know that it'll make you happier the more we smile, so I'll be sure to enjoy myself to the end! Happy anniversary, Rin!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Rin.
Also, great job on the event.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your half is coming to an end, so do everything you'd like to do and tell everyone everything you want them to know! And then let's make this the most memorable anniversary ever.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin! Once again, happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Since our anniversaries are on the same day, we usually celebrate together, but you know what? It's double the fun that way!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And if it's the two of us, I bet we can make it ten times or even a hundred times more fun! So let's enjoy ourselves to the fullest!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright everyone, let's wish Rin a happy anniversary one more time!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Co.
rows.Line: Happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You guys...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you! It's thanks to your help that we've been able to pull off an event as fun as this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: When we decided that I'd be the main MC, I had confidence that this event was going to be great no matter what because I knew that you guys were gonna be there with me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The reason why I'm able to smile like I am right now is because of you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you... Thank you from the bottom of my heart!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, it's time for the finale of my half!
Counting on you, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You got it! Everyone, let's have the best time ever!
